 241   def pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
 242     ret = -1
 243     pbPartyStarts(idxBattler).each_with_index do |start, i|
 244       break if start > idxParty
 245       ret = i
 246     end
 247     return ret
 248   end

 250   # Only used for the purpose of an error message when one trainer tries to

 253     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
 254     trainer = (opposes?(idxBattler)) ? @opponent : @player
 255     return (trainer.nil?) ? nil : trainer[idxTrainer]

 258   def pbGetOwnerName(idxBattler)
 259     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
 260     return @opponent[idxTrainer].full_name if opposes?(idxBattler)   # Opponent
 261     return @player[idxTrainer].full_name if idxTrainer > 0   # Ally trainer
 262     return @player[idxTrainer].name   # Player
 263   end

 265   def pbGetOwnerItems(idxBattler)
 266     if opposes?(idxBattler)
 267       return [] if !@items
 268       return @items[pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)]
 269     end
 270     return [] if !@ally_items

 274   # Returns whether the battler in position idxBattler is owned by the same
 275   # trainer that owns the Pokémon in party slot idxParty. This assumes that
 276   # both the battler position and the party slot are from the same side.
 277   def pbIsOwner?(idxBattler, idxParty)
 278     idxTrainer1 = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
 279     idxTrainer2 = pbGetOwnerIndexFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
 280     return idxTrainer1 == idxTrainer2
 281   end

 283   def pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
 284     return false if opposes?(idxBattler)
 285     return pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) == 0
 286   end

 288   # Returns the number of Pokémon positions controlled by the given trainerIndex
 289   # on the given side of battle.
 290   def pbNumPositions(side, idxTrainer)
 291     ret = 0
 292     pbSideSize(side).times do |i|
 293       t = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex((i * 2) + side)
 294       next if t != idxTrainer
 295       ret += 1
 296     end
 297     return ret
 298   end

 174   def pbCommandPhase
 175     @command_phase = true
 176     @scene.pbBeginCommandPhase
 177     # Reset choices if commands can be shown
 178     @battlers.each_with_index do |b, i|
 179       next if !b
 180       pbClearChoice(i) if pbCanShowCommands?(i)
 181     end
 182     # Reset choices to perform Mega Evolution if it wasn't done somehow
 183     2.times do |side|
 184       @megaEvolution[side].each_with_index do |megaEvo, i|
 185         @megaEvolution[side][i] = -1 if megaEvo >= 0
 186       end
 187     end
 188     # Choose actions for the round (player first, then AI)
 189     pbCommandPhaseLoop(true)    # Player chooses their actions
 190     if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions
 191       @command_phase = false
 192       return
 193     end
 194     pbCommandPhaseLoop(false)   # AI chooses their actions
 195     @command_phase = false
 196   end

 198   def pbCommandPhaseLoop(isPlayer)
 199     # NOTE: Doing some things (e.g. running, throwing a Poké Ball) takes up all
 200     #       your actions in a round.
 201     actioned = []
 202     idxBattler = -1
 203     loop do
 204       break if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions
 205       idxBattler += 1
 206       break if idxBattler >= @battlers.length
 207       next if !@battlers[idxBattler] || pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler) != isPlayer
 208       if @choices[idxBattler][0] != :None || !pbCanShowCommands?(idxBattler)
 209         # Action is forced, can't choose one
 210         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@battlers[idxBattler].pbThis} (#{idxBattler}) is forced to use a multi-turn move")
 211         next
 212       end
 213       # AI controls this battler
 214       if @controlPlayer || !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
 215         @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseEnemyCommand(idxBattler)
 216         next
 217       end
 218       # Player chooses an action
 219       actioned.push(idxBattler)
 220       commandsEnd = false   # Whether to cancel choosing all other actions this round
 221       loop do
 222         cmd = pbCommandMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
 223         # If being Sky Dropped, can't do anything except use a move
 224         if cmd > 0 && @battlers[idxBattler].effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
 225           pbDisplay(_INTL("Sky Drop won't let {1} go!", @battlers[idxBattler].pbThis(true)))
 226           next
 227         end
 228         case cmd
 229         when 0    # Fight
 230           break if pbFightMenu(idxBattler)
 231         when 1    # Bag
 232           if pbItemMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
 233             commandsEnd = true if pbItemUsesAllActions?(@choices[idxBattler][1])
 234             break
 235           end
 236         when 2    # Pokémon
 237           break if pbPartyMenu(idxBattler)
 238         when 3    # Run
 239           # NOTE: "Run" is only an available option for the first battler the
 240           #       player chooses an action for in a round. Attempting to run
 241           #       from battle prevents you from choosing any other actions in
 242           #       that round.
 243           if pbRunMenu(idxBattler)
 244             commandsEnd = true
 245             break
 246           end
 247         when 4    # Call
 248           break if pbCallMenu(idxBattler)
 249         when -2   # Debug
 250           pbDebugMenu
 251           next
 252         when -1   # Go back to previous battler's action choice
 253           next if actioned.length <= 1
 254           actioned.pop   # Forget this battler was done
 255           idxBattler = actioned.last - 1
 256           pbCancelChoice(idxBattler + 1)   # Clear the previous battler's choice
 257           actioned.pop   # Forget the previous battler was done
 258           break
 259         end
 260         pbCancelChoice(idxBattler)
 261       end
 262       break if commandsEnd
 263     end
 264   end
 265 end

   6     return false if fainted?
   7     # Wild roaming Pokémon always flee if possible
   8     if tryFlee && wild? &&
   9        @battle.rules["alwaysflee"] && @battle.pbCanRun?(@index)
  10       pbBeginTurn(choice)
  11       pbSEPlay("Battle flee")
  12       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} fled from battle!", pbThis))
  13       @battle.decision = 3
  14       pbEndTurn(choice)
  15       return true
  16     end
  17     # Shift with the battler next to this one
  18     if choice[0] == :Shift
  19       idxOther = -1
  20       case @battle.pbSideSize(@index)
  21       when 2
  22         idxOther = (@index + 2) % 4
  23       when 3
  24         if @index != 2 && @index != 3   # If not in middle spot already
  25           idxOther = (@index.even?) ? 2 : 3
  26         end
  27       end
  28       if idxOther >= 0
  29         @battle.pbSwapBattlers(@index, idxOther)
  30         case @battle.pbSideSize(@index)
  31         when 2
  32           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved across!", pbThis))
  33         when 3
  34           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} moved to the center!", pbThis))
  35         end
  36       end
  37       pbBeginTurn(choice)
  38       pbCancelMoves
  39       @lastRoundMoved = @battle.turnCount   # Done something this round
  40       return true
  41     end
  42     # If this battler's action for this round wasn't "use a move"
  43     if choice[0] != :UseMove
  44       # Clean up effects that end at battler's turn
  45       pbBeginTurn(choice)
  46       pbEndTurn(choice)
  47       return false
  48     end
  49     # Use the move
  50     PBDebug.log("[Use move] #{pbThis} (#{@index}) used #{choice[2].name}")
  51     PBDebug.logonerr { pbUseMove(choice, choice[2] == @battle.struggle) }
  52     @battle.pbJudge
  53     # Update priority order
  54     @battle.pbCalculatePriority if Settings::RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES
  55     return true
  56   end

  61   def pbBeginTurn(_choice)
  62     # Cancel some lingering effects which only apply until the user next moves
  63     @effects[PBEffects::DestinyBondPrevious] = @effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond]
  64     @effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond]         = false
  65     @effects[PBEffects::Grudge]              = false
  66     @effects[PBEffects::MoveNext]            = false
  67     @effects[PBEffects::Quash]               = 0
  68     # Encore's effect ends if the encored move is no longer available
  69     if @effects[PBEffects::Encore] > 0 && pbEncoredMoveIndex < 0
  70       @effects[PBEffects::Encore]     = 0
  71       @effects[PBEffects::EncoreMove] = nil
  72     end
  73   end

  75   # Called when the usage of various multi-turn moves is disrupted due to
  76   # failing pbTryUseMove, being ineffective against all targets, or because
  77   # Pursuit was used specially to intercept a switching foe.
  78   # Cancels the use of multi-turn moves and counters thereof. Note that Hyper
  79   # Beam's effect is NOT cancelled.
  80   def pbCancelMoves(full_cancel = false)
  81     # Outragers get confused anyway if they are disrupted during their final
  82     # turn of using the move
  83     if @effects[PBEffects::Outrage] == 1 && pbCanConfuseSelf?(false) && !full_cancel
  84       pbConfuse(_INTL("{1} became confused due to fatigue!", pbThis))
  85     end
  86     # Cancel usage of most multi-turn moves
  87     @effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack] = nil
  88     @effects[PBEffects::Rollout]       = 0
  89     @effects[PBEffects::Outrage]       = 0
  90     @effects[PBEffects::Uproar]        = 0
  91     @effects[PBEffects::Bide]          = 0
  92     @currentMove = nil if @effects[PBEffects::HyperBeam] == 0
  93     # Reset counters for moves which increase them when used in succession
  94     @effects[PBEffects::FuryCutter] = 0
  95   end

  97   def pbEndTurn(_choice)
  98     @lastRoundMoved = @battle.turnCount   # Done something this round
  99     if !@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] &&
 100        (hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF]) ||
 101        hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS))
 102       if @lastMoveUsed && pbHasMove?(@lastMoveUsed)
 103         @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = @lastMoveUsed
 104       elsif @lastRegularMoveUsed && pbHasMove?(@lastRegularMoveUsed)
 105         @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = @lastRegularMoveUsed
 106       end
 107     end
 108     @effects[PBEffects::BeakBlast]   = false
 109     @effects[PBEffects::Charge]      = 0 if @effects[PBEffects::Charge] == 1
 110     @effects[PBEffects::GemConsumed] = nil
 111     @effects[PBEffects::ShellTrap]   = false
 112     @battle.allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbContinualAbilityChecks }   # Trace, end primordial weathers

 115   def pbConfusionDamage(msg)
 116     @damageState.reset
 117     confusionMove = Battle::Move::Confusion.new(@battle, nil)
 118     confusionMove.calcType = confusionMove.pbCalcType(self)   # nil
 119     @damageState.typeMod = confusionMove.pbCalcTypeMod(confusionMove.calcType, self, self)   # 8
 120     confusionMove.pbCheckDamageAbsorption(self, self)
 121     confusionMove.pbCalcDamage(self, self)
 122     confusionMove.pbReduceDamage(self, self)
 123     self.hp -= @damageState.hpLost
 124     confusionMove.pbAnimateHitAndHPLost(self, [self])
 125     @battle.pbDisplay(msg)   # "It hurt itself in its confusion!"
 126     confusionMove.pbRecordDamageLost(self, self)
 127     confusionMove.pbEndureKOMessage(self)
 128     pbFaint if fainted?
 129     pbItemHPHealCheck
 130   end

 136   def pbUseMoveSimple(moveID, target = -1, idxMove = -1, specialUsage = true)
 137     choice = []
 138     choice[0] = :UseMove   # "Use move"
 139     choice[1] = idxMove    # Index of move to be used in user's moveset
 140     if idxMove >= 0
 141       choice[2] = @moves[idxMove]
 142     else
 143       choice[2] = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(moveID))
 144       choice[2].pp = -1
 145     end
 146     choice[3] = target     # Target (-1 means no target yet)
 147     PBDebug.log("[Use move] #{pbThis} used the called/simple move #{choice[2].name}")
 148     pbUseMove(choice, specialUsage)
 149   end

 154   def pbUseMove(choice, specialUsage = false)
 155     # NOTE: This is intentionally determined before a multi-turn attack can
 156     #       set specialUsage to true.
 157     skipAccuracyCheck = (specialUsage && choice[2] != @battle.struggle)
 158     # Start using the move
 159     pbBeginTurn(choice)
 160     # Force the use of certain moves if they're already being used
 161     if !@battle.futureSight
 162       if usingMultiTurnAttack?
 163         choice[2] = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(@currentMove))
 164         specialUsage = true
 165       elsif @effects[PBEffects::Encore] > 0 && choice[1] >= 0 &&
 166             @battle.pbCanShowCommands?(@index)
 167         idxEncoredMove = pbEncoredMoveIndex
 168         if idxEncoredMove >= 0 && choice[1] != idxEncoredMove &&
 169            @battle.pbCanChooseMove?(@index, idxEncoredMove, false)   # Change move if battler was Encored mid-round
 170           choice[1] = idxEncoredMove
 171           choice[2] = @moves[idxEncoredMove]
 172           choice[3] = -1   # No target chosen
 173         end
 174       end
 175     end
 176     # Labels the move being used as "move"
 177     move = choice[2]
 178     return if !move   # if move was not chosen somehow
 179     # Try to use the move (inc. disobedience)
 180     @lastMoveFailed = false
 181     if !pbTryUseMove(choice, move, specialUsage, skipAccuracyCheck)
 182       @lastMoveUsed     = nil
 183       @lastMoveUsedType = nil
 184       if !specialUsage
 185         @lastRegularMoveUsed   = nil
 186         @lastRegularMoveTarget = -1
 187       end
 188       @battle.pbGainExp   # In case self is KO'd due to confusion
 189       pbCancelMoves
 190       pbEndTurn(choice)
 191       return
 192     end
 193     move = choice[2]   # In case disobedience changed the move to be used
 194     return if !move   # if move was not chosen somehow
 195     # Subtract PP
 196     if !specialUsage && !pbReducePP(move)
 197       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} used {2}!", pbThis, move.name))
 198       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But there was no PP left for the move!"))
 199       @lastMoveUsed          = nil
 200       @lastMoveUsedType      = nil
 201       @lastRegularMoveUsed   = nil
 202       @lastRegularMoveTarget = -1
 203       @lastMoveFailed        = true
 204       pbCancelMoves
 205       pbEndTurn(choice)
 206       return
 207     end
 208     # Stance Change
 209     if isSpecies?(:AEGISLASH) && self.ability == :STANCECHANGE
 210       if move.damagingMove?
 211         pbChangeForm(1, _INTL("{1} changed to Blade Forme!", pbThis))
 212       elsif move.id == :KINGSSHIELD
 213         pbChangeForm(0, _INTL("{1} changed to Shield Forme!", pbThis))
 214       end
 215     end
 216     # Calculate the move's type during this usage
 217     move.calcType = move.pbCalcType(self)
 218     # Start effect of Mold Breaker
 219     @battle.moldBreaker = hasMoldBreaker?
 220     # Remember that user chose a two-turn move
 221     if move.pbIsChargingTurn?(self)
 222       # Beginning the use of a two-turn attack
 223       @effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack] = move.id
 224       @currentMove = move.id
 225     else
 226       @effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack] = nil   # Cancel use of two-turn attack
 227     end
 228     # Add to counters for moves which increase them when used in succession
 229     move.pbChangeUsageCounters(self, specialUsage)
 230     # Charge up Metronome item
 231     if hasActiveItem?(:METRONOME) && !move.callsAnotherMove?
 232       if @lastMoveUsed && @lastMoveUsed == move.id && !@lastMoveFailed
 233         @effects[PBEffects::Metronome] += 1
 234       else
 235         @effects[PBEffects::Metronome] = 0
 236       end
 237     end
 238     # Record move as having been used
 239     @lastMoveUsed     = move.id
 240     @lastMoveUsedType = move.calcType   # For Conversion 2
 241     if !specialUsage
 242       @lastRegularMoveUsed   = move.id   # For Disable, Encore, Instruct, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Spite
 243       @lastRegularMoveTarget = choice[3]   # For Instruct (remembering original target is fine)
 244       @movesUsed.push(move.id) if !@movesUsed.include?(move.id)   # For Last Resort
 245     end
 246     @battle.lastMoveUsed = move.id   # For Copycat
 247     @battle.lastMoveUser = @index   # For "self KO" battle clause to avoid draws
 248     @battle.successStates[@index].useState = 1   # Battle Arena - assume failure
 249     # Find the default user (self or Snatcher) and target(s)
 250     user = pbFindUser(choice, move)
 251     user = pbChangeUser(choice, move, user)
 252     targets = pbFindTargets(choice, move, user)
 253     targets = pbChangeTargets(move, user, targets)
 254     # Pressure
 255     if !specialUsage
 256       targets.each do |b|
 257         next unless b.opposes?(user) && b.hasActiveAbility?(:PRESSURE)
 258         PBDebug.log("[Ability triggered] #{b.pbThis}'s #{b.abilityName}")
 259         user.pbReducePP(move)
 260       end
 261       if move.pbTarget(user).affects_foe_side
 262         @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(user).each do |b|
 263           next unless b.hasActiveAbility?(:PRESSURE)
 264           PBDebug.log("[Ability triggered] #{b.pbThis}'s #{b.abilityName}")
 265           user.pbReducePP(move)
 266         end
 267       end
 268     end
 269     # Dazzling/Queenly Majesty make the move fail here
 270     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
 271       next if !b || !b.abilityActive?
 272       if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerMoveBlocking(b.ability, b, user, targets, move, @battle)
 273         @battle.pbDisplayBrief(_INTL("{1} used {2}!", user.pbThis, move.name))
 274         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(b)
 275         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cannot use {2}!", user.pbThis, move.name))
 276         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(b)
 277         user.lastMoveFailed = true
 278         pbCancelMoves
 279         pbEndTurn(choice)
 280         return
 281       end
 282     end
 283     # "X used Y!" message
 284     # Can be different for Bide, Fling, Focus Punch and Future Sight
 285     # NOTE: This intentionally passes self rather than user. The user is always
 286     #       self except if Snatched, but this message should state the original
 287     #       user (self) even if the move is Snatched.
 288     move.pbDisplayUseMessage(self)
 289     # Snatch's message (user is the new user, self is the original user)
 290     if move.snatched
 291       @lastMoveFailed = true   # Intentionally applies to self, not user
 292       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} snatched {2}'s move!", user.pbThis, pbThis(true)))
 293     end
 294     # "But it failed!" checks
 295     if move.pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
 296       PBDebug.log(sprintf("[Move failed] In function code %s's def pbMoveFailed?", move.function_code))
 297       user.lastMoveFailed = true
 298       pbCancelMoves
 299       pbEndTurn(choice)
 300       return
 301     end
 302     # Perform set-up actions and display messages
 303     # Messages include Magnitude's number and Pledge moves' "it's a combo!"
 304     move.pbOnStartUse(user, targets)
 305     # Self-thawing due to the move
 306     if user.status == :FROZEN && move.thawsUser?
 307       user.pbCureStatus(false)
 308       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} melted the ice!", user.pbThis))
 309     end
 310     # Powder
 311     if user.effects[PBEffects::Powder] && move.calcType == :FIRE
 312       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("Powder", user)
 313       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("When the flame touched the powder on the Pokémon, it exploded!"))
 314       user.lastMoveFailed = true
 315       if ![:Rain, :HeavyRain].include?(user.effectiveWeather) && user.takesIndirectDamage?
 316         user.pbTakeEffectDamage((user.totalhp / 4.0).round, false) do |hp_lost|
 317           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by Powder!", user.pbThis))
 318         end
 319         @battle.pbGainExp   # In case user is KO'd by this
 320       end
 321       pbCancelMoves
 322       pbEndTurn(choice)
 323       return
 324     end
 325     # Primordial Sea, Desolate Land
 326     if move.damagingMove?
 327       case @battle.pbWeather
 328       when :HeavyRain
 329         if move.calcType == :FIRE
 330           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The Fire-type attack fizzled out in the heavy rain!"))
 331           user.lastMoveFailed = true
 332           pbCancelMoves
 333           pbEndTurn(choice)
 334           return
 335         end
 336       when :HarshSun
 337         if move.calcType == :WATER
 338           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The Water-type attack evaporated in the harsh sunlight!"))
 339           user.lastMoveFailed = true
 340           pbCancelMoves
 341           pbEndTurn(choice)
 342           return
 343         end
 344       end
 345     end
 346     # Protean
 347     if user.hasActiveAbility?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN]) &&
 348        !move.callsAnotherMove? && !move.snatched &&
 349        user.pbHasOtherType?(move.calcType) && !GameData::Type.get(move.calcType).pseudo_type
 350       @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(user)
 351       user.pbChangeTypes(move.calcType)
 352       typeName = GameData::Type.get(move.calcType).name
 353       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s type changed to {2}!", user.pbThis, typeName))
 354       @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(user)
 355       # NOTE: The GF games say that if Curse is used by a non-Ghost-type
 356       #       Pokémon which becomes Ghost-type because of Protean, it should
 357       #       target and curse itself. I think this is silly, so I'm making it
 358       #       choose a random opponent to curse instead.
 359       if move.function_code == "CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDef1" && targets.length == 0
 360         choice[3] = -1
 361         targets = pbFindTargets(choice, move, user)
 362       end
 363     end
 364     # For two-turn moves when they charge and attack in the same turn
 365     move.pbQuickChargingMove(user, targets)
 366     #---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 367     magicCoater  = -1
 368     magicBouncer = -1
 369     if targets.length == 0 && move.pbTarget(user).num_targets > 0 && !move.worksWithNoTargets?
 370       # def pbFindTargets should have found a target(s), but it didn't because
 371       # they were all fainted
 372       # All target types except: None, User, UserSide, FoeSide, BothSides
 373       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But there was no target..."))
 374       user.lastMoveFailed = true
 375     else   # We have targets, or move doesn't use targets
 376       # Reset whole damage state, perform various success checks (not accuracy)
 377       @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
 378         b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
 379         b.statsDropped = false
 380       end
 381       targets.each do |b|
 382         b.damageState.reset
 383         next if pbSuccessCheckAgainstTarget(move, user, b, targets)
 384         b.damageState.unaffected = true
 385       end
 386       # Magic Coat/Magic Bounce checks (for moves which don't target Pokémon)
 387       if targets.length == 0 && move.statusMove? && move.canMagicCoat?
 388         @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
 389           next if b.fainted? || !b.opposes?(user)
 390           next if b.semiInvulnerable?
 391           if b.effects[PBEffects::MagicCoat]
 392             magicCoater = b.index
 393             b.effects[PBEffects::MagicCoat] = false
 394             break
 395           elsif b.hasActiveAbility?(:MAGICBOUNCE) && !@battle.moldBreaker &&
 396                 !b.effects[PBEffects::MagicBounce]
 397             magicBouncer = b.index
 398             b.effects[PBEffects::MagicBounce] = true
 399             break
 400           end
 401         end
 402       end
 403       # Get the number of hits
 404       numHits = move.pbNumHits(user, targets)
 405       # Process each hit in turn
 406       realNumHits = 0
 407       numHits.times do |i|
 408         break if magicCoater >= 0 || magicBouncer >= 0
 409         success = pbProcessMoveHit(move, user, targets, i, skipAccuracyCheck)
 410         if !success
 411           if i == 0 && targets.length > 0
 412             hasFailed = false
 413             targets.each do |t|
 414               next if t.damageState.protected
 415               hasFailed = t.damageState.unaffected
 416               break if !t.damageState.unaffected
 417             end
 418             user.lastMoveFailed = hasFailed
 419           end
 420           break
 421         end
 422         realNumHits += 1
 423         break if user.fainted?
 424         break if [:SLEEP, :FROZEN].include?(user.status)
 425         # NOTE: If a multi-hit move becomes disabled partway through doing those
 426         #       hits (e.g. by Cursed Body), the rest of the hits continue as
 427         #       normal.
 428         break if targets.none? { |t| !t.fainted? }   # All targets are fainted
 429       end
 430       # Battle Arena only - attack is successful
 431       @battle.successStates[user.index].useState = 2
 432       if targets.length > 0
 433         @battle.successStates[user.index].typeMod = 0
 434         targets.each do |b|
 435           next if b.damageState.unaffected
 436           @battle.successStates[user.index].typeMod += b.damageState.typeMod
 437         end
 438       end
 439       # Effectiveness message for multi-hit moves
 440       # NOTE: No move is both multi-hit and multi-target, and the messages below
 441       #       aren't quite right for such a hypothetical move.
 442       if numHits > 1
 443         if move.damagingMove?
 444           targets.each do |b|
 445             next if b.damageState.unaffected || b.damageState.substitute
 446             move.pbEffectivenessMessage(user, b, targets.length)
 447           end
 448         end
 449         if realNumHits == 1
 450           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("Hit 1 time!"))
 451         elsif realNumHits > 1
 452           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("Hit {1} times!", realNumHits))
 453         end
 454       end
 455       # Magic Coat's bouncing back (move has targets)
 456       targets.each do |b|
 457         next if b.fainted?
 458         next if !b.damageState.magicCoat && !b.damageState.magicBounce
 459         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(b) if b.damageState.magicBounce
 460         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} bounced the {2} back!", b.pbThis, move.name))
 461         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(b) if b.damageState.magicBounce
 462         newChoice = choice.clone
 463         newChoice[3] = user.index
 464         newTargets = pbFindTargets(newChoice, move, b)
 465         newTargets = pbChangeTargets(move, b, newTargets)
 466         success = false
 467         if !move.pbMoveFailed?(b, newTargets)
 468           newTargets.each_with_index do |newTarget, idx|
 469             if pbSuccessCheckAgainstTarget(move, b, newTarget, newTargets)
 470               success = true
 471               next
 472             end
 473             newTargets[idx] = nil
 474           end
 475           newTargets.compact!
 476         end
 477         pbProcessMoveHit(move, b, newTargets, 0, false) if success
 478         b.lastMoveFailed = true if !success
 479         targets.each { |otherB| otherB.pbFaint if otherB&.fainted? }
 480         user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
 481       end
 482       # Magic Coat's bouncing back (move has no targets)
 483       if magicCoater >= 0 || magicBouncer >= 0
 484         mc = @battle.battlers[(magicCoater >= 0) ? magicCoater : magicBouncer]
 485         if !mc.fainted?
 486           user.lastMoveFailed = true
 487           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(mc) if magicBouncer >= 0
 488           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} bounced the {2} back!", mc.pbThis, move.name))
 489           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(mc) if magicBouncer >= 0
 490           success = false
 491           if !move.pbMoveFailed?(mc, [])
 492             success = pbProcessMoveHit(move, mc, [], 0, false)
 493           end
 494           mc.lastMoveFailed = true if !success
 495           targets.each { |b| b.pbFaint if b&.fainted? }
 496           user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
 497         end
 498       end
 499       # Move-specific effects after all hits
 500       targets.each { |b| move.pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, b) }
 501       # Faint if 0 HP
 502       targets.each { |b| b.pbFaint if b&.fainted? }
 503       user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
 504       # External/general effects after all hits. Eject Button, Shell Bell, etc.
 505       pbEffectsAfterMove(user, targets, move, realNumHits)
 506       @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
 507         b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
 508         b.statsDropped = false
 509       end
 510     end
 511     # End effect of Mold Breaker
 512     @battle.moldBreaker = false
 513     # Gain Exp
 514     @battle.pbGainExp
 515     # Battle Arena only - update skills
 516     @battle.allBattlers.each { |b| @battle.successStates[b.index].updateSkill }
 517     # Shadow Pokémon triggering Hyper Mode
 518     pbHyperMode if @battle.choices[@index][0] != :None   # Not if self is replaced
 519     # End of move usage

   6   # prevent Pokémon action. Relevant because these effects can become active
   7   # earlier in the same round (after choosing the command but before using the
   8   # move) or an unusable move may be called by another move such as Metronome.

  10   def pbCanChooseMove?(move, commandPhase, showMessages = true, specialUsage = false)
  11     # Disable
  12     if @effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] == move.id && !specialUsage
  13       if showMessages
  14         msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} is disabled!", pbThis, move.name)
  15         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  16       end
  17       return false
  18     end
  19     # Heal Block
  20     if @effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 0 && move.healingMove?
  21       if showMessages
  22         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Heal Block!", pbThis, move.name)
  23         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  24       end
  25       return false
  26     end
  27     # Gravity
  28     if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0 && move.unusableInGravity?
  29       if showMessages
  30         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of gravity!", pbThis, move.name)
  31         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  32       end
  33       return false
  34     end
  35     # Throat Chop
  36     if @effects[PBEffects::ThroatChop] > 0 && move.soundMove?
  37       if showMessages
  38         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Throat Chop!", pbThis, move.name)
  39         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  40       end
  41       return false
  42     end
  43     # Choice Band/Gorilla Tactics
  44     @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !pbHasMove?(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
  45     if @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] && move.id != @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand]
  46       choiced_move = GameData::Move.try_get(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
  47       if choiced_move
  48         if hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF])
  49           if showMessages
  50             msg = _INTL("The {1} only allows the use of {2}!", itemName, choiced_move.name)
  51             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  52           end
  53           return false
  54         elsif hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
  55           if showMessages
  56             msg = _INTL("{1} can only use {2}!", pbThis, choiced_move.name)
  57             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  58           end
  59           return false
  60         end
  61       end
  62     end
  63     # Taunt
  64     if @effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0 && move.statusMove? && !specialUsage
  65       if showMessages
  66         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} after the taunt!", pbThis, move.name)
  67         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  68       end
  69       return false
  70     end
  71     # Torment
  72     if @effects[PBEffects::Torment] && !@effects[PBEffects::Instructed] && !specialUsage &&
  73        @lastMoveUsed && move.id == @lastMoveUsed && move.id != @battle.struggle.id
  74       if showMessages
  75         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use the same move twice in a row due to the torment!", pbThis)
  76         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  77       end
  78       return false
  79     end
  80     # Imprison
  81     if @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Imprison] && b.pbHasMove?(move.id) }
  82       if showMessages
  83         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use its sealed {2}!", pbThis, move.name)
  84         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  85       end
  86       return false
  87     end
  88     # Assault Vest (prevents choosing status moves but doesn't prevent
  89     # executing them)
  90     if hasActiveItem?(:ASSAULTVEST) && move.statusMove? && move.function_code != "UseMoveTargetIsAboutToUse" && commandPhase
  91       if showMessages
  92         msg = _INTL("The effects of the {1} prevent status moves from being used!", itemName)
  93         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  94       end
  95       return false
  96     end
  97     # Belch
  98     return false if !move.pbCanChooseMove?(self, commandPhase, showMessages)

 103   # Obedience check
 104   #=============================================================================
 105   # Return true if Pokémon continues attacking (although it may have chosen to
 106   # use a different move in disobedience), or false if attack stops.
 107   def pbObedienceCheck?(choice)
 108     return true if usingMultiTurnAttack?
 109     return true if choice[0] != :UseMove
 110     return true if !@battle.internalBattle
 111     return true if !@battle.pbOwnedByPlayer?(@index)
 112     disobedient = false
 113     # Pokémon may be disobedient; calculate if it is
 114     badge_level = 10 * (@battle.pbPlayer.badge_count + 1)
 115     badge_level = GameData::GrowthRate.max_level if @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= 8
 116     if Settings::ANY_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY ||
 117        (Settings::FOREIGN_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY && @pokemon.foreign?(@battle.pbPlayer))
 118       if @level > badge_level
 119         a = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
 120         disobedient |= (a >= badge_level)
 121       end
 122     end
 123     disobedient |= !pbHyperModeObedience(choice[2])
 124     return true if !disobedient
 125     # Pokémon is disobedient; make it do something else
 126     return pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
 127   end

 129   def pbDisobey(choice, badge_level)
 130     move = choice[2]
 131     PBDebug.log("[Disobedience] #{pbThis} disobeyed")
 132     @effects[PBEffects::Rage] = false
 133     # Do nothing if using Snore/Sleep Talk
 134     if @status == :SLEEP && move.usableWhenAsleep?
 135       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders and kept sleeping!", pbThis))
 136       return false
 137     end
 138     b = ((@level + badge_level) * @battle.pbRandom(256) / 256).floor
 139     # Use another move
 140     if b < badge_level
 141       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ignored orders!", pbThis))
 142       return false if !@battle.pbCanShowFightMenu?(@index)
 143       otherMoves = []
 144       eachMoveWithIndex do |_m, i|
 145         next if i == choice[1]
 146         otherMoves.push(i) if @battle.pbCanChooseMove?(@index, i, false)
 147       end
 148       return false if otherMoves.length == 0   # No other move to use; do nothing
 149       newChoice = otherMoves[@battle.pbRandom(otherMoves.length)]
 150       choice[1] = newChoice
 151       choice[2] = @moves[newChoice]
 152       choice[3] = -1
 153       return true
 154     end
 155     c = @level - badge_level
 156     r = @battle.pbRandom(256)
 157     # Fall asleep
 158     if r < c && pbCanSleep?(self, false)
 159       pbSleepSelf(_INTL("{1} began to nap!", pbThis))
 160       return false
 161     end
 162     # Hurt self in confusion
 163     r -= c
 164     if r < c && @status != :SLEEP
 165       pbConfusionDamage(_INTL("{1} won't obey! It hurt itself in its confusion!", pbThis))
 166       return false
 167     end
 168     # Show refusal message and do nothing
 169     case @battle.pbRandom(4)
 170     when 0 then @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} won't obey!", pbThis))
 171     when 1 then @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} turned away!", pbThis))
 172     when 2 then @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is loafing around!", pbThis))
 173     when 3 then @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} pretended not to notice!", pbThis))
 174     end
 175     return false
 176   end

 179   # Check whether the user (self) is able to take action at all.

 182   #=============================================================================
 183   def pbTryUseMove(choice, move, specialUsage, skipAccuracyCheck)
 184     # Check whether it's possible for self to use the given move
 185     # NOTE: Encore has already changed the move being used, no need to have a
 186     #       check for it here.
 187     if !pbCanChooseMove?(move, false, true, specialUsage)
 188       @lastMoveFailed = true
 189       return false
 190     end
 191     # Check whether it's possible for self to do anything at all
 192     if @effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0   # Intentionally no message here
 193       PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} can't use #{move.name} because of being Sky Dropped")
 194       return false
 195     end
 196     if @effects[PBEffects::HyperBeam] > 0   # Intentionally before Truant
 197       PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} is recharging after using #{move.name}")
 198       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} must recharge!", pbThis))
 199       @effects[PBEffects::Truant] = !@effects[PBEffects::Truant] if hasActiveAbility?(:TRUANT)
 200       return false
 201     end
 202     if choice[1] == -2   # Battle Palace
 203       PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} can't act in the Battle Palace somehow")
 204       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} appears incapable of using its power!", pbThis))
 205       return false
 206     end
 207     # Skip checking all applied effects that could make self fail doing something
 208     return true if skipAccuracyCheck
 209     # Check status problems and continue their effects/cure them
 210     case @status
 211     when :SLEEP
 212       self.statusCount -= 1
 213       if @statusCount <= 0
 214         pbCureStatus
 215       else
 216         pbContinueStatus
 217         if !move.usableWhenAsleep?   # Snore/Sleep Talk
 218           PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} is asleep")
 219           @lastMoveFailed = true
 220           return false
 221         end
 222       end
 223     when :FROZEN
 224       if !move.thawsUser?
 225         if @battle.pbRandom(100) < 20
 226           pbCureStatus
 227         else
 228           pbContinueStatus
 229           PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} is frozen")
 230           @lastMoveFailed = true
 231           return false
 232         end
 233       end
 234     end
 235     # Obedience check
 236     return false if !pbObedienceCheck?(choice)
 237     # Truant
 238     if hasActiveAbility?(:TRUANT)
 239       @effects[PBEffects::Truant] = !@effects[PBEffects::Truant]
 240       if !@effects[PBEffects::Truant]   # True means loafing, but was just inverted
 241         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self)
 242         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is loafing around!", pbThis))
 243         @lastMoveFailed = true
 244         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
 245         PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} can't act because of #{abilityName}")
 246         return false
 247       end
 248     end
 249     # Flinching
 250     if @effects[PBEffects::Flinch]
 251       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} flinched and couldn't move!", pbThis))
 252       PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} flinched")
 253       if abilityActive?
 254         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnFlinch(self.ability, self, @battle)
 255       end
 256       @lastMoveFailed = true
 257       return false
 258     end
 259     # Confusion
 260     if @effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 0
 261       @effects[PBEffects::Confusion] -= 1
 262       if @effects[PBEffects::Confusion] <= 0
 263         pbCureConfusion
 264         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} snapped out of its confusion.", pbThis))
 265       else
 266         @battle.pbCommonAnimation("Confusion", self)
 267         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is confused!", pbThis))
 268         threshold = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7) ? 33 : 50   # % chance
 269         if @battle.pbRandom(100) < threshold
 270           pbConfusionDamage(_INTL("It hurt itself in its confusion!"))
 271           PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} hurt itself in its confusion")
 272           @lastMoveFailed = true
 273           return false
 274         end
 275       end
 276     end
 277     # Paralysis
 278     if @status == :PARALYSIS && @battle.pbRandom(100) < 25
 279       pbContinueStatus
 280       PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} is paralyzed")
 281       @lastMoveFailed = true
 282       return false
 283     end
 284     # Infatuation
 285     if @effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0
 286       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("Attract", self)
 287       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is in love with {2}!", pbThis,
 288                               @battle.battlers[@effects[PBEffects::Attract]].pbThis(true)))
 289       if @battle.pbRandom(100) < 50
 290         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is immobilized by love!", pbThis))
 291         PBDebug.log("[Move failed] #{pbThis} is immobilized by love")
 292         @lastMoveFailed = true
 293         return false
 294       end
 295     end
 296     return true
 297   end

 313     end

   4 def _pbNextComb(comb, length)
   5   i = comb.length - 1
   6   loop do
   7     valid = true
   8     (i...comb.length).each do |j|
   9       if j == i
  10         comb[j] += 1
  11       else
  12         comb[j] = comb[i] + (j - i)
  13       end
  14       if comb[j] >= length
  15         valid = false
  16         break
  17       end
  18     end
  19     return true if valid
  20     i -= 1
  21     break unless i >= 0
  22   end
  23   return false
  24 end

  26 # Iterates through the array and yields each combination of _num_ elements in
  27 # the array.
  28 def pbEachCombination(array, num)
  29   return if array.length < num || num <= 0
  30   if array.length == num
  31     yield array
  32     return
  33   elsif num == 1
  34     array.each do |x|
  35       yield [x]
  36     end
  37     return
  38   end
  39   currentComb = []
  40   arr = []
  41   num.times { |i| currentComb[i] = i }
  42   loop do
  43     num.times { |i| arr[i] = array[currentComb[i]] }
  44     yield arr
  45     break unless _pbNextComb(currentComb, array.length)
  46   end
  47 end

   8   #=============================================================================
   9   # Makes sure all Pokémon exist that need to. Alter the type of battle if
  10   # necessary. Will never try to create battler positions, only delete them
  11   # (except for wild Pokémon whose number of positions are fixed). Reduces the
  12   # size of each side by 1 and tries again. If the side sizes are uneven, only
  13   # the larger side's size will be reduced by 1 each time, until both sides are
  14   # an equal size (then both sides will be reduced equally).
  15   #=============================================================================
  16   def pbEnsureParticipants
  17     # Prevent battles larger than 2v2 if both sides have multiple trainers
  18     # NOTE: This is necessary to ensure that battlers can never become unable to
  19     #       hit each other due to being too far away. In such situations,
  20     #       battlers will move to the centre position at the end of a round, but
  21     #       because they cannot move into a position owned by a different
  22     #       trainer, it's possible that battlers will be unable to move close
  23     #       enough to hit each other if there are multiple trainers on both
  24     #       sides.
  25     if trainerBattle? && (@sideSizes[0] > 2 || @sideSizes[1] > 2) &&
  26        @player.length > 1 && @opponent.length > 1
  27       raise _INTL("Can't have battles larger than 2v2 where both sides have multiple trainers")
  28     end
  29     # Find out how many Pokémon each trainer has
  30     side1counts = pbAbleTeamCounts(0)
  31     side2counts = pbAbleTeamCounts(1)
  32     # Change the size of the battle depending on how many wild Pokémon there are
  33     if wildBattle? && side2counts[0] != @sideSizes[1]
  34       if @sideSizes[0] == @sideSizes[1]
  35         # Even number of battlers per side, change both equally
  36         @sideSizes = [side2counts[0], side2counts[0]]
  37       else
  38         # Uneven number of battlers per side, just change wild side's size
  39         @sideSizes[1] = side2counts[0]
  40       end
  41     end
  42     # Check if battle is possible, including changing the number of battlers per
  43     # side if necessary
  44     loop do
  45       needsChanging = false
  46       2.times do |side|   # Each side in turn
  47         next if side == 1 && wildBattle?   # Wild side's size already checked above
  48         sideCounts = (side == 0) ? side1counts : side2counts
  49         requireds = []
  50         # Find out how many Pokémon each trainer on side needs to have
  51         @sideSizes[side].times do |i|
  52           idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex((i * 2) + side)
  53           requireds[idxTrainer] = 0 if requireds[idxTrainer].nil?
  54           requireds[idxTrainer] += 1
  55         end
  56         # Compare the have values with the need values
  57         if requireds.length > sideCounts.length
  58           raise _INTL("Error: def pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex gives invalid owner index ({1} for battle type {2}v{3}, trainers {4}v{5})",
  59                       requireds.length - 1, @sideSizes[0], @sideSizes[1], side1counts.length, side2counts.length)
  60         end
  61         sideCounts.each_with_index do |_count, i|
  62           if !requireds[i] || requireds[i] == 0
  63             case side
  64             when 0
  65               raise _INTL("Player-side trainer {1} has no battler position for their Pokémon to go (trying {2}v{3} battle)",
  66                           i + 1, @sideSizes[0], @sideSizes[1])
  67             when 1
  68               raise _INTL("Opposing trainer {1} has no battler position for their Pokémon to go (trying {2}v{3} battle)",
  69                           i + 1, @sideSizes[0], @sideSizes[1])
  70             end
  71           end
  72           next if requireds[i] <= sideCounts[i]   # Trainer has enough Pokémon to fill their positions
  73           if requireds[i] == 1
  74             raise _INTL("Player-side trainer {1} has no able Pokémon", i + 1) if side == 0
  75             raise _INTL("Opposing trainer {1} has no able Pokémon", i + 1) if side == 1
  76           end
  77           # Not enough Pokémon, try lowering the number of battler positions
  78           needsChanging = true
  79           break
  80         end
  81         break if needsChanging
  82       end
  83       break if !needsChanging
  84       # Reduce one or both side's sizes by 1 and try again
  85       if wildBattle?
  86         PBDebug.log("#{@sideSizes[0]}v#{@sideSizes[1]} battle isn't possible " +
  87                     "(#{side1counts} player-side teams versus #{side2counts[0]} wild Pokémon)")
  88         newSize = @sideSizes[0] - 1
  89       else
  90         PBDebug.log("#{@sideSizes[0]}v#{@sideSizes[1]} battle isn't possible " +
  91                     "(#{side1counts} player-side teams versus #{side2counts} opposing teams)")
  92         newSize = @sideSizes.max - 1
  93       end
  94       if newSize == 0
  95         raise _INTL("Couldn't lower either side's size any further, battle isn't possible")
  96       end
  97       2.times do |side|
  98         next if side == 1 && wildBattle?   # Wild Pokémon's side size is fixed
  99         next if @sideSizes[side] == 1 || newSize > @sideSizes[side]
 100         @sideSizes[side] = newSize
 101       end

 103     end

 519   def pbDecisionOnTime
 520     counts   = [0, 0]
 521     hpTotals = [0, 0]
 522     2.times do |side|
 523       pbParty(side).each do |pkmn|
 524         next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
 525         counts[side]   += 1
 526         hpTotals[side] += pkmn.hp
 527       end
 528     end
 529     return 1 if counts[0] > counts[1]       # Win (player has more able Pokémon)
 530     return 2 if counts[0] < counts[1]       # Loss (foe has more able Pokémon)
 531     return 1 if hpTotals[0] > hpTotals[1]   # Win (player has more HP in total)
 532     return 2 if hpTotals[0] < hpTotals[1]   # Loss (foe has more HP in total)
 533     return 5                                # Draw
 534   end

 313   # Called when one or more Pokémon switch in. Does a lot of things, including

 316   def pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler_index, skip_event_reset = false)
 317     battler_index = [battler_index] if !battler_index.is_a?(Array)
 318     battler_index.flatten!
 319     # NOTE: This isn't done for switch commands, because they previously call
 320     #       pbRecallAndReplace, which could cause Neutralizing Gas to end, which
 321     #       in turn could cause Intimidate to trigger another Pokémon's Eject
 322     #       Pack. That Eject Pack should trigger at the end of this method, but
 323     #       this resetting would prevent that from happening, so it is skipped
 324     #       and instead done earlier in def pbAttackPhaseSwitch.
 325     if !skip_event_reset
 326       allBattlers.each do |b|
 327         b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
 328         b.statsDropped = false
 329       end
 330     end
 331     # For each battler that entered battle, in speed order
 332     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
 333       next if !battler_index.include?(b.index) || b.fainted?
 334       pbRecordBattlerAsParticipated(b)
 335       pbMessagesOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b)
 336       # Position/field effects triggered by the battler appearing
 337       pbEffectsOnBattlerEnteringPosition(b)   # Healing Wish/Lunar Dance
 338       pbEntryHazards(b)
 339       # Battler faints if it is knocked out because of an entry hazard above
 340       if b.fainted?
 341         b.pbFaint
 342         pbGainExp
 343         pbJudge
 344         next
 345       end
 346       b.pbCheckForm
 347       # Primal Revert upon entering battle
 348       pbPrimalReversion(b.index)
 349       # Ending primordial weather, checking Trace
 350       b.pbContinualAbilityChecks(true)
 351       # Abilities that trigger upon switching in
 352       if (!b.fainted? && b.unstoppableAbility?) || b.abilityActive?
 353         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.ability, b, self, true)
 354       end
 355       pbEndPrimordialWeather   # Checking this again just in case
 356       # Items that trigger upon switching in (Air Balloon message)
 357       if b.itemActive?
 358         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnSwitchIn(b.item, b, self)
 359       end
 360       # Berry check, status-curing ability check
 361       b.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
 362       b.pbAbilityStatusCureCheck
 363     end
 364     # Check for triggering of Emergency Exit/Wimp Out/Eject Pack (only one will
 365     # be triggered)
 366     pbPriority(true).each do |b|
 367       break if b.pbItemOnStatDropped
 368       break if b.pbAbilitiesOnDamageTaken
 369     end
 370     allBattlers.each do |b|
 371       b.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
 372       b.statsDropped = false
 373     end
 374   end

 438     ##### LOSE, DRAW #####

 492           $player.party[idxParty - 1].givePokerus(strain)
 493         end

 495           $player.party[idxParty + 1].givePokerus(strain)

 501     @battlers.each do |b|

 519   def pbDecisionOnTime
 520     counts   = [0, 0]
 521     hpTotals = [0, 0]
 522     2.times do |side|
 523       pbParty(side).each do |pkmn|
 524         next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
 525         counts[side]   += 1
 526         hpTotals[side] += pkmn.hp
 527       end
 528     end
 529     return 1 if counts[0] > counts[1]       # Win (player has more able Pokémon)
 530     return 2 if counts[0] < counts[1]       # Loss (foe has more able Pokémon)
 531     return 1 if hpTotals[0] > hpTotals[1]   # Win (player has more HP in total)
 532     return 2 if hpTotals[0] < hpTotals[1]   # Loss (foe has more HP in total)
 533     return 5                                # Draw
 534   end

   9   def pbCanSwitchIn?(idxBattler, idxParty, partyScene = nil)
  10     return true if idxParty < 0
  11     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
  12     return false if idxParty >= party.length
  13     return false if !party[idxParty]
  14     if party[idxParty].egg?
  15       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("An Egg can't battle!"))
  16       return false
  17     end
  18     if !pbIsOwner?(idxBattler, idxParty)
  19       if partyScene
  20         owner = pbGetOwnerFromPartyIndex(idxBattler, idxParty)
  21         partyScene.pbDisplay(_INTL("You can't switch {1}'s Pokémon with one of yours!", owner.name))
  22       end
  23       return false
  24     end
  25     if party[idxParty].fainted?
  26       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} has no energy left to battle!", party[idxParty].name))
  27       return false
  28     end
  29     if pbFindBattler(idxParty, idxBattler)
  30       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is already in battle!", party[idxParty].name))
  31       return false
  32     end
  33     return true
  34   end

  36   # Check whether the currently active Pokémon (at battler index idxBattler) can

  38   def pbCanSwitchOut?(idxBattler, partyScene = nil)
  39     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
  40     return true if battler.fainted?
  41     # Ability/item effects that allow switching no matter what
  42     if battler.abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.ability, battler, self)
  43       return true
  44     end
  45     if battler.itemActive? && Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCertainSwitching(battler.item, battler, self)
  46       return true
  47     end
  48     # Other certain switching effects
  49     return true if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS && battler.pbHasType?(:GHOST)
  50     # Other certain trapping effects
  51     if battler.trappedInBattle?
  52       partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} can't be switched out!", battler.pbThis))
  53       return false
  54     end
  55     # Trapping abilities/items
  56     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|
  57       next if !b.abilityActive?
  58       if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.ability, battler, b, self)
  59         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.abilityName))
  60         return false
  61       end
  62     end
  63     allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|

  65       if Battle::ItemEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.item, battler, b, self)
  66         partyScene&.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} prevents switching!", b.pbThis, b.itemName))
  67         return false
  68       end
  69     end
  70     return true

 370                   battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct")   # Sky Drop

 379       battle.decision = 3   # Escaped
 380       next true
 381     end

 383     next false if battle.pbAllFainted?(battler.idxOpposingSide)
 384     next false if !battle.pbCanSwitchOut?(battler.index)   # Battler can't switch out
 385     next false if !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(battler.index)   # No Pokémon can switch in
 386     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler, true)
 387     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
 388     if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 389       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} activated!", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
 390     end
 391     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} went back to {2}!",
 392        battler.pbThis, battle.pbGetOwnerName(battler.index)))
 393     if battle.endOfRound   # Just switch out
 394       battle.scene.pbRecall(battler.index) if !battler.fainted?
 395       battler.pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut   # Inc. primordial weather check
 396       next true
 397     end
 398     newPkmn = battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(battler.index)   # Owner chooses
 399     next false if newPkmn < 0   # Shouldn't ever do this
 400     battle.pbRecallAndReplace(battler.index, newPkmn)
 401     battle.pbClearChoice(battler.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
 402     battle.moldBreaker = false if move_user && battler.index == move_user.index
 403     battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler.index)

 284   def pbCanSleepYawn?
 285     return false if self.status != :NONE
 286     if affectedByTerrain? && [:Electric, :Misty].include?(@battle.field.terrain)
 287       return false
 288     end
 289     if !hasActiveAbility?(:SOUNDPROOF) && @battle.allBattlers.any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] > 0 }
 290       return false
 291     end
 292     if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunityNonIgnorable(self.ability, self, :SLEEP)
 293       return false
 294     end
 295     # NOTE: Bulbapedia claims that Flower Veil shouldn't prevent sleep due to
 296     #       drowsiness, but I disagree because that makes no sense. Also, the
 297     #       comparable Sweet Veil does prevent sleep due to drowsiness.
 298     if abilityActive? && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatusImmunity(self.ability, self, :SLEEP)
 299       return false
 300     end
 301     allAllies.each do |b|
 302       next if !b.abilityActive?

 304       return false

 309     return false if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Safeguard] > 0
 310     return true

 405     else
 406       anim_name = GameData::Status.get(self.status).animation
 407       @battle.pbCommonAnimation(anim_name, self) if anim_name
 408     end
 409     yield if block_given?
 410     case self.status
 411     when :SLEEP
 412       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is fast asleep.", pbThis))
 413     when :POISON
 414       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was hurt by poison!", pbThis))
 415     when :BURN
 416       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was hurt by its burn!", pbThis))
 417     when :PARALYSIS
 418       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is paralyzed! It can't move!", pbThis))
 419     when :FROZEN
 420       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is frozen solid!", pbThis))
 421     end

 157   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
 158     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:SUCTIONCUPS) && !@battle.moldBreaker
 159       if show_message

 161         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 162           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself!", target.pbThis))
 163         else
 164           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself with {2}!", target.pbThis, target.abilityName))
 165         end

 167       end
 168       return true
 169     end
 170     if target.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
 171       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchored itself with its roots!", target.pbThis)) if show_message
 172       return true
 173     end
 174     if target.wild? && target.allAllies.length == 0 && @battle.canRun
 175       # End the battle
 176       if target.level > user.level
 177         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
 178         return true
 179       end
 180     elsif !target.wild?
 181       # Switch target out
 182       canSwitch = false
 183       @battle.eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(target.index) do |_pkmn, i|
 184         canSwitch = @battle.pbCanSwitchIn?(target.index, i)

 186       end

 189         return true

 193       return true
